query: We're onboarding a new customer to Luzmo IQ next week. Can you audit their datasets and suggest better column descriptions and AI context before they go live?
IQ keeps answering 'revenue' questions with the gross amount instead of net. I think our column descriptions are misleading. Can you review them and propose fixes?
Our dataset descriptions only exist in English but our end users work in Dutch and French. Translate the Luzmo descriptions and push them after I approve.
Review the AI rules and saved agents in our Luzmo account. Some rules were never published and I'm not sure which agents link them.
Can you check whether the formulas in our orders dataset actually match their descriptions, and suggest new formulas for metrics people ask IQ about?
Run our usual end-user questions through IQ before and after we update the dataset metadata so we can compare the answers.
Generate a review page of proposed description and AI context changes for our Luzmo datasets so our data owner can sign off before anything is written.
The AI context on our datasets is a mess of copy-pasted notes and dashboard references. Clean it up for IQ without losing the useful definitions.
Restore the dataset descriptions from the backup taken before yesterday's semantic layer update.
IQ picks the wrong dataset for support-ticket questions. Improve the dataset-level descriptions and AI context so it chooses the right one.
Embed the IQ Chat component in our React app and scope the embed token to three datasets.
How do I call /aiprompt from our Node backend and render the returned chart in our own UI?
Connect our Postgres database to Luzmo and keep the orders table in sync every hour.
Write a script that renames every dataset with a 'tmp_' prefix and deletes the unused ones.
Make our embedded IQ Chat match our dark brand colors and font.
Getting an IQ license error in the console when the chat component loads. Is IQ a separate add-on?
Set up the hosted Luzmo MCP server in Claude Desktop with our API key.
Each tenant must only see their own rows in IQ answers. How do I add the embed filter?
